text:
maria-docs: FYI I opened PR #4217 to revise the delete/retention playbook and update the SDK delete examples. Need SOC2-friendly phrasing and a quick link fix to the SDK repo. TL;DR: clarify what 'deleted' means w.r.t backups and show v2 SDK snippets.

sam-secal: thanks — can you call out which exact lines worry you? is it the 'will be permanently deleted' sentence?

maria-docs: exactly. current copy says 'data will be permanently deleted within 24 hours' which legal flagged. Also one example links to github.com/redwood/sdk/v1/delete (404) — should point to v2. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4217

katie-legal: @maria-docs quick suggestion: avoid absolute guarantees. Use phrasing like: "We make commercially reasonable efforts to delete customer data from active systems and to remove it from backups in accordance with our retention policy; residual copies may persist in backups or logs for a limited period." Also add a line about legal holds: "We retain data subject to legal obligations or regulatory holds."

maria-docs: ok good. want me to add both sentences and mark the backups bit as "may persist up to X days" or keep it vague like 'limited period'?

katie-legal: keep it conservative: 'a limited period' is fine. If you want a number we need product to approve the SLA.

lee-sdk: I can update the code snippets. Current Python example uses `client.delete_item('/v1/items/{id}')` — should be `client.items.delete(id)` in v2. Curl: replace `curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v1/items/123` with `curl -X DELETE https://api.redwood.ai/v2/items/123`. Also update the SDK repo link to https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/tree/main/examples/delete (I'll push a tiny README fix in the SDK repo).

anya-ux: small UX note — add a sentence explaining what the user sees in the Console after deletion (e.g., 'marked as deleted' vs 'gone'). Helps set expectations.

maria-docs: good call. I'll add: "In the Redwood Console deleted items appear as 'Removed' for 24 hours, then are excluded from queries; API clients will receive 404 post-deletion." — is that accurate @lee-sdk?

lee-sdk: 404 part is correct for v2; the Console wording we control — docs can lean on "Removed" as the temporary state.

sam-secal: also check the audit log snippet — we should show the audit event for deletion. Small sample: ```json
{"event":"item.delete","user":"acct-123","item_id":"abc","ts":"2025-10-01T12:34:56Z"}
```

maria-docs: adding that audit event now. I'll also add a small snippet showing how to query audit logs for deletions.

lee-sdk: pushed the SDK README link fix (PR 78) and updated python/curl examples in my branch.

deploy-bot: CI for docs PR #4217: all checks passed :white_check_mark: (build 8423)

maria-docs: thanks everyone — I'll incorporate Katie's wording, Lee's v2 snippets, Anya's Console note, and Sam's audit example. Will request a final review after the edits. Planning to merge EOD if no objections. :thumbsup:
